asks: Asks the commission to divide Lethbridge into four urban-rural hybrid districts radiating into the surrounding southern Alberta region, including one reaching the Crowsnest Pass.

quote: Dividing the city of Lethbridge into four urban-rural hybrid electoral divisions would not create a new regional structure; it would simply formalize the one that already governs southern Alberta in practice.
note: Proposing an IDEA in reply to the interim report's call for further analysis. Confirms particulars in answers: 'four MLAs tied to it' (EB-632) and, to the Chair's 'you can't be suggesting that a section of Lethbridge be included with the Crowsnest Pass', answers 'I can and I do' (EB-633). Also accepts the Chair's description of six hybrid southern ridings ('Mr. Mills: Yes.').

Answering a commissioner's question whether Red Deer should be hybridized: 'I don't know everything about the city of Red Deer to say whether or not the hybrid model is appropriate for them.' No stance.

asks: Asks for one west-central riding with all of Clearwater County kept whole, western Mountain View County including Sundre and Cremona, and the MD of Bighorn, without Canmore.

quote: The ideal outcome is one west-central Alberta riding, with one MLA representing all of Clearwater county, western Mountain View county, including Sundre and Cremona
note: Rejection of the interim split: 'Clearwater county must remain whole. [...] dividing them would weaken their representation' (pp. 197-198, before EB-629).

quote: one MLA representing all of Clearwater county, western Mountain View county, including Sundre and Cremona and the MD of Bighorn, excluding Canmore and Banff national park, including the town of Banff.
note: Wants the MD of Bighorn in the west-central riding and Canmore out, which is the B1 shape; the park/townsite wording is garbled as transcribed ('excluding Canmore and Banff national park, including the town of Banff') and may mean the reverse for the townsite. Rejects the interim tie of Nordegg/west Clearwater to the mountain parks: 'if you ask the communities of Nordegg if they themselves identify with the other mountain parks, they would tell you unequivocally that they do not' (EB-630). Search and rescue coverage 'from Clearwater county to the Banff boundary' offered as support.

quote: one west-central Alberta riding, with one MLA representing all of Clearwater county, western Mountain View county, including Sundre and Cremona
note: Sundre and western Mountain View County with the foothills riding (codebook: 'Sundre belongs with Rocky Mountain House' is O1 here). Says nothing of Crossfield, Irricana or Beiseker.

asks: Asks the commission to restore a Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding in some form west of Red Deer County, accepting Red Deer County split between two MLAs so ridings north and south can follow the Highway 2 corridor.

quote: To me, we need that riding of Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre in some form to kind of better condense the ridings north and south of Red Deer county along the highway 2 corridor
note: Rejects the loss of the riding ('concern with the loss of the Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding', pp. 202-204) and the joining of Rocky with Lacombe: 'when I look north at Lacombe being in the same riding as Rocky Mountain House, I don't think they're going to have effective representation' (EB-635). The Lacombe objection is aimed at the interim Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House but argues against the Lacombe-Rocky pairing that W2 also makes. 'In some form' -> direction.
City of Red Deer named only as a Highway 2 corridor community; speaks to Red Deer County, not the city's districts.
Olds named as the community to the south; Sundre named as part of the old riding ('communities like Rocky Mountain House, Sundre, that were already existing') without a stated placement request.

asks: Supports keeping Bowden, Innisfail, Penhold, Delburne and Elnora together and asks that Trochu (crossing into Kneehill County) be joined with them along the Highway 21 corridor.

quote: were you proposing to straddle the Red Deer county line there into Kneehill? Mr. Reckseidler: Yes, definitely.
note: Answer 'yes' to a commissioner's description: Trochu (in the Olds/Mountain View-Kneehill riding on every map) moved into the Innisfail riding with Delburne and Elnora. Neither O1 nor O2. Says Trochu 'has always been lumped in with Three Hills'.
City of Red Deer named only as where young people work; no stance on the city's districts. Rule 8.

asks: Asks the commission to retain Jasper in West Yellowhead rather than join it with Banff.

Supports the proposed Banff-Jasper riding as long as Banff and Canmore stay together (indifferent on Jasper), rejects pairing Canmore with the Crowsnest Pass, and asks that the riding be renamed with Canmore first.

note: Mentions the Sundre mayor's idea to put Sundre with Banff and Jasper only to reject moving Canmore away; no request about where Sundre goes. Never speaks of joining park lands with Rocky Mountain House, so no RMH-B code (CANMORE-JASPER only).

asks: Asks on behalf of Medicine Hat city council for one mainly urban Medicine Hat riding, returning to the pre-2017 Carry Drive boundary with only a southern slice of the city in a Cypress hybrid, with Redcliff joined to the city.
The City of Airdrie supports the interim Airdrie-East and Airdrie-West ridings as proposed.

quote: We do feel like this representation of the Airdrie area within the two ridings, which are Airdrie-East and AirdrieWest, simply is the right choice for right now in terms of our growth
note: Mayor of Airdrie. Also says north Calgary is 'a very, very different demographic [...] really not representative of what our interests and growth challenges are' (answer on rural components); not coded as a rejection of A2 (no words against a joint district).

Crossfield and Irricana named as growing communities in the Airdrie-East area; general support for the proposed ridings, but no request about where Crossfield or Irricana belong. Narrower code per rule 17.

asks: Asks that Medicine Hat have at least one solely urban riding, possibly with a more natural boundary.

note: Named as a comparator mid-size city with fully urban ridings (rule 6).

asks: Asks that the Innisfail riding keep the Highway 2 towns (Innisfail, Penhold, adding Blackfalds) and Highway 21 communities as far as Trochu, swap Sylvan Lake to the Lacombe riding, and if needed take in south Red Deer around Westerner Park.

quote: There could be some population gained there by the Westerner Park, which is a large ag society that is probably better represented by a rural MLA.
note: Offered to make up population: 'some areas along the city of Red Deer, Westerner Park for example, that are near Gasoline Alley in the development in the south side of Red Deer' (EB-651/652); cut-off 'south of 19th Street in Red Deer and highway 595' (EB-652), moved into the rural Innisfail riding. Some of the area named is Red Deer County, not the city; whether city residents are involved needs a boundary lookup. Not the four-way plan.

quote: the population that would go to Sylvan would go farther north and then into Kneehill county, into that Trochu area down south.
note: Trochu area of Kneehill County into the Innisfail riding; confirmed 'only as far south as Trochu, not Three Hills? Mr. Dreeshen: Correct.' (EB-652). Neither O1 nor O2.
Rocky Mountain House named only as where Eckville and Caroline workers go; no request about the west-central riding.

asks: Wild Rose School Division asks that the current boundaries affecting Clearwater County remain as they are, with the county kept whole in the Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding.

quote: We are here to respectfully request that the current electoral boundaries affecting Clearwater county remain as they are.
note: Rejection (EB-654): 'Splitting Clearwater county into multiple constituencies would result in families being represented by MLAs who may not represent the communities where their children attend school.' Answers yes to the Chair ('You would like a return to the Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding. Is that what you're saying?' / 'The Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre. Yeah.'), transcript order scrambled.

asks: The Town of Crossfield supports the interim Airdrie-East and Airdrie-West ridings, including Crossfield in Airdrie-East.

quote: The city of Airdrie strongly supports the commission's proposed creation of Airdrie-West and Airdrie-East electoral divisions, including the incorporation of the town of Crossfield within Airdrie-East.
note: Mayor of Crossfield, partly reading the City of Airdrie's round 2 text, then: 'The town of Crossfield strongly encourages the commission to consider the commission's proposed redistribution scenarios for Airdrie-East and Airdrie-West.'

quote: Crossfield supports redistribution scenarios that are centred on Airdrie and include Crossfield, with an Airdrie-aligned electoral division.
note: 'Crossfield belongs with Airdrie' is O2 per codebook. Says nothing of Sundre or Mountain View County.

asks: Asks the commission to adopt the alternative Okotoks-Diamond Valley riding (appendix H) keeping Okotoks, Diamond Valley, Millarville and rural Highwood together under the Highwood name, instead of a Calgary-Okotoks riding.
RMA asks the commission to use wider population variances and more section 15(2) districts to keep or add rural seats rather than cut them, and to reconsider expanding hybrid ridings.
